title: Compose RF networks across wave conventions
hypothesis: Default wave/reference assumptions pass common 50-ohm controls but break equivalent encodings of the same connected physical networks.
why_hard: Complex reference impedances and wave conventions must preserve the physical circuit during composition. A correct scikit-rf wrapper is allowed; source 047's actual failure mechanism remains unaudited.
next_action: Audit source 047's seventh assertion, then compare a convention-aware scikit-rf baseline with an independently assembled nodal oracle.

sources.note: Brainstorm New Tasks, design message c360defc-431f-4eb3-926b-2bf1e633eb70; BR-002/D02. Retrieved prefix, not verified benchmark/model evidence.

notes: BR-002/D02; main scientific preparation candidate. Proposed eight circuit pairs, four representations and sixteen frequencies. GOLD-Z ablation supplies individual physical matrices. Reported 128 checks are discussion claims with no retrieved raw evidence; no local trials.
